summary: Cosan S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing a simplification plan: two executives (CFO and Chief Legal Officer) resigned with a successor named, an EGM will vote on bylaw amendments and a spin-off of Radar II followed by merger into Cosan and Mansilla, and voluntary delisting of its NYSE-listed ADRs (each representing 4 common shares) with a subsequent SEC deregistration. The filing provides no financial terms, prices, or advisors. The restructuring signals a strategic simplification, but the delisting and spin-off are contingent on shareholder and regulatory approvals. What to watch: EGM outcome and delisting timeline for ADS holders.
